name: Phuchka
instructions: 1. Knead semolina and flour into a stiff dough, roll into small thin discs, and deep-fry until they puff up into golden hollow spheres.
2. Mash boiled potatoes with black chickpeas, roasted cumin, black salt, red chili powder, ginger, and coriander to create the filling.
3. Prepare the tangy water by mixing tamarind pulp, water, black salt, cumin powder, and crushed green chilies.
4. Poke a hole in the center of the fried shell, stuff with the potato mixture, and dip into the spicy tamarind water before serving.
description: Phuchka is the iconic street food of Kolkata, distinct from its counterparts in other regions due to the use of spicy, tangy tamarind water and a potato filling that is heavily spiced with roasted Bengal spices. It is a quintessential social snack often enjoyed at street-side stalls.
